notes.title: New character - Daddy Gator
notes.notes: [h1]Papa Caré: the old alligator[/h1][p][/p][p]The launch of the next Quacolé Tennis demo is approaching and the cast is getting bigger and bigger.[/p][p]Daddy Gator is here to show young people how to play tennis like a pro. His dives can catch the most distant balls and his float-racket will send opponents far away![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kqG1K9z4AoM"][/dynamiclink]If you already thought the floats on the beach court were a problem, beating this guy will be a big challenge. Speaking of floats, the next demo will bring even crazier new obstacles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368135/704efb47107d7cf2c5bc2f9fd107904cd8e60219.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New character - Droppo
notes.notes: [h1]Droppo: the brainless water[/h1][p][/p][p]Another new character joins the Quacolé Tennis cast. Droppo is here to show that intelligence is not a requirement for playing well. He may not be one of the smartest players, but his water attacks can be truly explosive. If you face him in a match, be prepared for the craziest moves. Also, bring a towel, because you might get wet.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KdpiQA0EsD4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In addition to the new characters, the demo will also feature new courts and balls. Quacolé Tennis matches are becoming increasingly crazy and unpredictable![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368135/8d447cbdf75e40b99d3362e710b39dfe45fbc883.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New character - Sandro
notes.notes: [h1]Sandro: the demonic flower[/h1][p][/p][p]The Quacolé Tennis cast is growing. And now, Sandro will make his opponents eat dust. Don't be fooled by his delicate appearance. This flower has nothing but hatred and malice flowing through its roots. He has no arms or legs, but that doesn't stop him from playing tennis.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bGE6RTQPlFY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Sandro will be waiting for you in the next demo update, which will be available for free later this year. Get ready for the craziest tennis matches ever and stay tuned, because we'll have a lot more news coming soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368135/95658a8c564de5704b9d8a3944990ef8edf19016.png"][/img][/p]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Enjoy the local co-op games festival
notes.notes:
This week is Steam Couch Co-op Fest, a festival that promotes cooperative games on Steam!

How about enjoying the festival by playing Quacolé Tennis? Call a friend and play the co-op campaign together! There are 9 doubles tennis matches against the most skillful opponents.

Play together on the same computer or live in the 21st century and play from the comfort of your own home via Steam Remote Play Together!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GjqzZIjXIAAi13W?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

notes.title: New Demo update now available
notes.notes:
Following feedback from everyone who has played Quacolé Tennis over the last month, I've updated the game to make it even better and more fun. The changes include:

-Difficulty balancing (can you beat that dog now?)
-Improved controls
-Adjustments to the movement pattern of the buoys
-Platforms on top of the buoys (it's now safe to jump on them. You use the jump, right?)
-Adjustments to the responsiveness of the interfaces
-Tutorial flow changes
-Graphics processing optimizations
-Minor bug fixes
-Dubbing of the match narrator

If you've played previous versions of Quacolé Tennis, give this new version a try and let me know what you think. Don't forget to leave a review on the demo page and tell all your friends about Quacolé Tennis!
